summary: Nike kit (white/black/gold). École Noir&Blanc (SCO Fonds de Dotation) front centre with the l'atoll chest roundel and the Ville d'Angers collar mark; Système U on the shorts; Ligue 1 McDonald's patch and 1TEAM mark on the sleeve. Sponsor list not confirmed complete: the club's kit launch names only Nike and École Noir&Blanc (plus unnamed 'partenaires historiques'), and the places of l'atoll, Ville d'Angers, the league patch and 1TEAM come from the club's photos, not from a text source. Viwone, Sorare and Groupe Actual are official partners without a known shirt placement.
